name: Run Progress
description: Timed runs with per-player checkpoints, collectibles, finish conditions, restart and a configurable HUD.

changelog.notes: The run HUD fits phones: Restart moves from the bottom-right corner (under the jump button) to under the clock, panels stack in the shared HUD layout instead of overlapping other HUDs, the controls hint matches the device, and the completion screen hides the touch controls while it is open.
Hit points show unless Health & Respawn's Health Bar is turned off, so older Health & Respawn copies keep their bar.
A missing spawn marker respawns players on its area's floor, not mid-air, and a checkpoint/marker count mismatch shows as a problem.
HUD setting: Full, one big centred timer, or Hidden for a custom HUD. Health shows only when Health & Respawn turns its bar on.
A missing spawn marker no longer stops the course: players respawn at the matching area, or at Health & Respawn's point.
Timed course runs with per-player checkpoints, collectible goals, restart, best times, a persisted leaderboard and a themed HUD.
